meta.scope: Representative Irish/EU SmPC-derived rheumatology prescribing dataset. Device-specific instructions remain product-specific.
meta.ui_note: Exact brand/formulation selection restored. Brand-specific SmPC/EMA provenance is shown; Humira may serve as an explicitly labelled reference only for unextracted adalimumab fields.
meta.patient_model: Patient accordions mirror the csDMARD education structure: purpose, administration, common side effects, stop/hold red flags, monitoring/tests, practical safety advice, and product/resource links.
meta.clinician_rule: Clinician accordions contain in-app section summaries. External SmPC links are supplemental provenance/deep links, not instructions to look up missing core information.
meta.source_hierarchy: Exact medicines.ie product SmPC first; if unavailable, exact HPRA product/SmPC; if unavailable or HPRA routes centrally authorised documentation to EMA, exact EMA product information/SmPC. Never substitute an active-ingredient landing page as product provenance.
meta.source_audit_status: Source hierarchy implemented; exact-brand provenance audit is ongoing and unresolved entries must be labelled rather than silently substituted.

Rheumatoid arthritis.dose: Oral once weekly; exact initiation/titration depends on selected product. Do not prescribe daily.

pre: HBV/HCV; HIV according to current guidance/risk
contra: Hypersensitivity to methotrexate or excipients.
Severe hepatic impairment / significant active liver disease as defined by the selected product.
Severe renal impairment according to the selected product threshold.
Pre-existing blood dyscrasias or significant bone-marrow suppression.
Serious, acute or chronic infections and immunodeficiency syndromes where specified.
Stomatitis or active gastrointestinal ulcer disease where specified.
Pregnancy for non-oncological indications; breastfeeding where contraindicated by the selected product.
Concurrent live vaccination during methotrexate therapy where specified.
warn: Methotrexate for inflammatory disease is taken once weekly; daily administration errors can be fatal.
Monitor FBC, renal function and liver tests; toxicity increases with renal impairment and interacting medicines.
New persistent cough or breathlessness requires prompt assessment for methotrexate-associated pneumonitis/lung toxicity.
Assess hepatic risk and alcohol exposure; persistent liver-test abnormalities require evaluation.
Serious skin reactions, infection, cytopenia and gastrointestinal toxicity require prompt review.
inter: Avoid trimethoprim/co-trimoxazole because of risk of severe bone-marrow suppression.
Review NSAIDs, antibiotics, proton-pump inhibitors and other medicines that can alter renal elimination or increase methotrexate toxicity; clinical significance depends on dose and context.
Avoid additional hepatotoxic medicines/alcohol excess where clinically relevant.
preg: Contraindicated in pregnancy for non-oncological indications. Apply current SmPC contraception/washout requirements to women and men where applicable.
Breastfeeding advice must follow the selected product's current section 4.6.
ae: Common effects include nausea, abdominal/GI symptoms, mouth ulcers, headache/fatigue and liver-enzyme abnormalities.
Red flags: fever/infection, severe mouth ulceration, unexplained bruising/bleeding, jaundice, severe GI symptoms, new persistent cough or breathlessness.
monitor: Monitoring frequency depends on medicine, dose, treatment phase, comorbidity and concomitant therapy.
For csDMARDs use current BSR/local monitoring schedules in addition to SmPC requirements.
